meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 集成 Matrix 聊天频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Matrix 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Matrix chat channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Matrix chat to your application

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过 Matrix 聊天 SDK 添加对 Matrix 频道（如 Element）的支持，使机器人能加入房间并收发消息。
howto.when: 当用户运行 `/manage-channels` 命令将 Matrix 频道连接到代理组时触发。需要先完成机器人账号注册和凭据配置。

say.text: 帮我添加 Matrix 频道，连接到我的 Element 聊天。
say.note: 开始执行技能步骤，复制适配器并注册。

say.text: 配置 Matrix 机器人账号，使用用户名和密码登录。
say.note: 触发凭据配置流程，提示输入 homeserver 等信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude adds Matrix channel support via the Chat SDK, enabling the bot to join rooms and send/receive messages on Matrix (e.g., Element).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user runs `/manage-channels` to wire the Matrix channel to an agent group. Requires prior bot account registration and credential setup.

say_en.text: Add a Matrix channel and connect it to my Element chat.
say_en.note: Starts the skill steps: copy adapter and register.

say_en.text: Configure the Matrix bot account using username and password.
say_en.note: Triggers credential prompts for homeserver URL, user ID, etc.
